title: Kissed Herbal Brazilian Chickpeas Skillet
description: A halal-friendly Brazilian dish featuring chickpeas in a molten herbal skillet, perfect for a brunch mood, this recipe dehydrates the chickpeas to bring out their natural sweetness.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit to dehydrate the chickpeas.
Rinse the chickpeas and spread them on a baking sheet to dehydrate in the oven for 30 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the dehydrated chickpeas, dried thyme, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the skillet simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped scallions and serve the skillet hot.
